instruction: In the "microsoft/vscode" repository, locate the most recent open pull request carrying the label "triage-needed", then write it out in the format "#<number> | <labels> | <title>" to "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_prs_3_3.txt". Should no matching pull request exist, the file should be saved empty.
reference_command: gh pr list --repo microsoft/vscode --search 'label:"triage-needed" sort:created-desc' --limit 1 --json number,title,labels --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) | \(([.labels[].name] | if length == 0 then "none" else join(",") end)) | \(.title)"' > "$HOME/Desktop/gh_open_prs_3_3.txt"
